## §Scope boundary

**Root paths explored:**
- `services/scraper/` — M2 primary implementation surface; currently M0 stub (`stub_main.py`, `Dockerfile` only).
- `bishop_shared/` — cross-service constants; M1 extended with `SQLITE_DB_*`; likely home for scraper wire enums or `STATE_WORKER_URL` client base.
- `docker-compose.yml` — `scraper` service block: `STATE_WORKER_URL`, `depends_on: state-worker: service_healthy`, image `bishop/scraper:m0`.
- `services/state-worker/app/routers/{manifest,scraper_state}.py` — reverse dependency: scraper consumes `POST /manifest/batch`, `GET/POST /scraper-state/{source}` (M1 landed).
- `tests/test_compose.py` — image-tag convention test will require amendment when scraper moves to `:m2`.
- `bishop_spec_0_6.md` L762–873, L81–103, L1147–1182, L1456–1460 — normative adapter/loop/rate-limit prose.

**Explicit exclusions:**
- `services/state-worker/` implementation changes — M1 owns REST surface; scraper is HTTP client only unless audit-amendment required.
- `services/{pre-filter-worker,content-scraper,enrichment-batcher,batch-poller,vector-writer,query-api,ui}/` — other milestone stubs.
- Non-ArXiv adapters (HuggingFace, PapersWithCode, SemanticScholar, GitHub, OpenReview, LessWrong) — charter M2 non-goals.
- `fetch_content` implementation — deferred to M4; ABC method must exist but body is out of M2 scope.
- Domain routing §19.2–19.3, personal domain §3.2, Appendix C adapters — charter adjacent/non-goals.
- Full backfill chunking orchestration (§18.4) — M8; M2 needs only `since` resolution for first run + incremental runs.
- `.venv/`, `node_modules/` — tooling.
- `alembic/` — no scraper DB writes; state-worker sole SQLite writer.
